title.ko: s'adresser au public, la règle de trois, questions rhétoriques, appel à l'action
title.en: Writing speeches: addressing the audience, rule of three, rhetorical questions, call to action

explain.ko: 좋은 연설문은 청중에게 직접 말하고 리듬과 설득 장치를 사용합니다. ① 호칭: Mesdames et Messieurs, chers amis. ② 3의 법칙: 세 가지를 나열 (le passé, le présent et l'avenir). ③ 수사 의문: Si nous n'agissons pas maintenant, qui le fera ? ④ 대조: Ce n'est pas ..., c'est ... ⑤ 행동 촉구: Il est temps d'agir. / Agissons ensemble. ⑥ 맺음: Enfin, merci de votre attention. 짧은 문장과 반복으로 기억에 남게 하세요.
explain.en: A good speech addresses the audience directly and uses rhythm and persuasion. First, address: Mesdames et Messieurs, chers amis. Second, rule of three: list three items (le passé, le présent et l'avenir). Third, rhetorical question: Si nous n'agissons pas maintenant, qui le fera ? Fourth, contrast: Ce n'est pas …, c'est … Fifth, call to action: Il est temps d'agir. / Agissons ensemble. Sixth, closing: Enfin, merci de votre attention. Short sentences and repetition make it memorable.

trans.en: Good speeches use several techniques. First, the rule of three repeats three points. Second, rhetorical questions address the audience. Third, a call to action in the ending.

items.passage: Aujourd'hui, je voudrais vous parler de trois choses : le chemin parcouru, la situation actuelle et la direction que nous prenons. Le chemin n'est pas facile, mais avec (1) et responsabilité, nous avancerons (2) à pas. Ensemble, nous (3) y arriver.

trans.ko: 오늘 저는 세 가지를 말씀드리고자 합니다. 우리가 걸어온 길, 우리가 서 있는 곳, 그리고 우리가 향할 곳입니다. 이 길은 쉽지 않지만 우리는 용기와 책임감으로 한 걸음씩 나아갈 것입니다.
trans.en: Today I'd like to speak about three things: the road we have travelled, where we stand, and where we are heading. The road is not easy, but with courage and responsibility we will move forward step by step.

items.passage:
EXTRAIT DE DISCOURS
Discours de remise des diplômes
Chers diplômés, vous êtes aujourd'hui sur une nouvelle ligne de départ. Quand les difficultés viendront, souvenez-vous du temps passé ici. Et demandez-vous : qu'ai-je appris aujourd'hui ? Que ferai-je demain ?

trans.ko:

졸업식 축사
졸업생 여러분, 여러분은 이제 새로운 출발선에 서 있습니다. 앞으로 어려움이 닥칠 때마다 이곳에서의 시간을 기억하십시오. 그리고 자신에게 물어보십시오. 나는 오늘 무엇을 배웠는가? 나는 내일 무엇을 할 것인가?
trans.en:
SPEECH EXTRACT
Graduation address
Graduates, you now stand at a new starting line. Whenever hardship comes, remember your time here. And ask yourselves: what did I learn today? What will I do tomorrow?
